data.name: Glyph Gambit
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Glyph Gambit is a turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by chess, Dark Souls, and grid-based dungeon crawlers. Each run challenges you to navigate dangerous tactical arenas where every move matters and every decision can end your journey. Your objective is clear:

Destroy the enemy King before they destroy yours.

You control multiple upgradable pieces on compact battle grids, facing distinct enemy factions with their own movement patterns and threats. Equip offensive Edges, defensive Shields, and powerful Gems and Items to shape your build and survive deeper into the gauntlet.

At the heart of the game are Glyphs—the soul of your run. Glyphs empower your piece, unlock new abilities, and fuel long-term progression. But they are fragile. If you fall in battle, your Glyphs drop on that level. To reclaim them, you must return to that same encounter and clear it. Fail again before recovery, and those Glyphs are lost forever.

Tactical Combat on Compact Grids

Fight on small, focused encounter boards where positioning is everything. Predict enemy intent, manage danger zones, and outmaneuver rival Kings. Every run presents new tactical puzzles that reward smart planning and bold plays.

A Souls-Inspired Challenge Loop

Death resets the run—but permanent upgrades, unlocked items, and new Glyphs progressively expand your options. Each attempt pushes you further as you refine your strategy and piece loadout.

Distinct Enemy Factions & Bosses

Face Goblin raiders, Sage spellcasters, Usurpers, Plague creatures, Warlords, and ancient Tyrant bosses—each with unique attack shapes and movement patterns that challenge you to adapt and survive.

Build Your Piece With Permanent Items

Equip a wide range of upgrades including:

  • Edges – Offensive stat boosts

  • Shields – Defensive enhancements

  • Gems – For upgrading edges and shields

  • Glyphs – The soul of the game for leveling up and purchasing items

  • Permanent Items  - Items that can be used across all runs

  • Run Items - Items that can be used for one run

  • Level Items - Items that can be used for one level in a run

  • Consumables - Items that are applied and consumed immediately

Designed for Controllers & Steam Deck

Featuring full controller support and clean UI navigation, Glyph Gambit plays naturally on both desktop and Steam Deck.

FEATURES

  • Turn-based tactical battles on compact grid arenas

  • Roguelite runs with permanent progression and unlocks

  • Core objective: destroy their King before they destroy yours

  • Glyphs that drop on death and can be lost forever

  • Dozens of Edges, Shields, and Gems to shape your build

  • Procedural encounters and branching run paths

  • Distinct factions with unique patterns and bosses

  • Souls-like atmosphere and challenge

  • Full controller support and Steam Deck compatible

  • Highly replayable with deep strategic choices

data.short_description: A turn-based tactical roguelite where you battle across grid-based arenas, destroy the enemy King before they destroy yours, and protect your Glyphs—lost if you fall, recoverable only by clearing the level where they dropped.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent (1.8 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 compatible GPU (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ (or equivalent distro)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ compatible GPU (Mesa drivers supported)
